options: An operated system needing SLOs, an incident playbook, drift watch, and a deprecation plan
explanation: Shipping is the middle, not the end.

options: Latency, quality, guardrail pass rate, cost, and availability - not just uptime
explanation: Alert on the tail and the rate, not the mean.

stem: Users escalate more but no error-rate alert fires. Missing…
options: A quality SLO - the feature returns successful-but-worse answers
explanation: LLM features fail by fluent wrong answers, not errors (2.8).

options: Which versions were live (prompt, model, index) and were they what you evaluated
explanation: A silent vendor model bump is the classic cause.

stem: The most useful sentence in an AI incident is…
options: 'Here is exactly what the model received' - sayable only if you traced it
explanation: The trace (5.7) makes the investigation a checklist.

stem: Answers worsen overnight with no code change: likely cause…
options: The vendor rolled the model version under you - check trace version vs evaluated, pin/roll back
explanation: Floating versions change behaviour with no deploy (9.2).

options: The world changed (new questions, updated docs); watch online signals and grow the golden set
explanation: A static golden set slowly goes out of date (3.5, 8.5).

options: A gated rollout to the successor (canary -> eval gate -> shift), because the model is pinned behind the gateway
explanation: A rollout ladder (8.5), not an emergency.

stem: A live system-prompt edit without a deploy is wrong because…
options: A prompt is code: it must be versioned, eval-gated and rollback-able
explanation: An untested live edit can silently regress (4.4, 8.4).

options: Your existing change-management and on-call discipline applied to a probabilistic component
explanation: Prompts, models, indexes, guardrails are versioned artefacts.
